children: Long.xyz co-founder Nate said the project will continue building assets and products around Robinhood Chain and will stick to an "RWA pairings only" strategy focused on pairing real-world assets. According to Odaily, he said the model could form a new asset class and further connect on-chain assets with the real world.

Nate said BONER and MEME both saw rapid growth after listing, and their liquidity has continued to deepen after the initial gains. He said Long.xyz's RWA pairing model has been preliminarily validated, remains in an early stage, and the next goal is to scale further and move toward 100x growth.

title: Long.xyz Co-Founder Says Project Will Continue Building Around Robinhood Chain
